cells.gaps: No figure from checking a register against the ID is given: the 1,628,587 NINs validated for the social register (NGA-007) are a count of checks, not of records removed or corrected. The tax use rests on the law and a law firm's account (NGA-013, NGA-008), with no count of tax records keyed on the NIN.
cells.note: The social register (NGA-006, NGA-007) and online voter registration (NGA-010) use the NIN, and under the 2026 identity law filing tax returns requires it, with the NIN the individual tax number since January 2026 (NGA-013, NGA-008): three main registers, stage 4. Stage 5 needs a matching figure.
